positions.statement: In the Capital Chronicle questionnaire, Sanders says Oregon needs to build more housing.
positions.excerpt: We need to build more housing, full stop.

source.publisher: Oregon Capital Chronicle

positions.statement: He proposes a tax credit for rural childcare workers modeled on the rural nurse practitioner tax credit.
positions.excerpt: I want to create a tax credit for rural childcare WORKERS similar to the rural nurse practitioner tax credit.

source.publisher: Oregon Capital Chronicle

positions.statement: He says Oregonians have consistently supported the state's sanctuary status and reproductive rights protections.
positions.excerpt: Oregonians have consistently supported our sanctuary state status and our protections of reproductive rights.

source.publisher: Oregon Capital Chronicle

positions.statement: The Capital Chronicle reports Sanders said there must be a data center moratorium until the state can determine how to proceed.
positions.excerpt: We have to make sure that we've got a moratorium until we can figure out how to make sure

collection_notes: Open seat (Rep. Jeff Helfrich running for Senate per CapChron guide); not incumbent, left null since no official source. 'hypocritehank.com' appears in coverage but is run by Hege's PAC, so it is not a campaign site and was not used. Inventory name matches. WW and Capital Chronicle 10/15 articles could not be fetched. Pamphlet says Sanders is nominated by the Independent Party of Oregon. No campaign website printed. Pamphlet also quotes two testimonials (not endorser lists) from a Parkdale pear farmer and a Hood River nurse.
